description: List all Splitwise friends. Use this to resolve a friend's name to a user_id before adding them to a group or building a custom expense split. The compact default returns id, name (first_name + last_name joined), email, registration_status and any non-empty balance per friend; pass view:'full' for Splitwise's raw records, which keep first_name and last_name separate.

view.description: Response shape. compact returns {id, name, email, registration_status, balance} per person — `name` is first_name + last_name joined, so the separate fields are on "full" only; "full" returns Splitwise's whole record. "brief" answers "what do I owe / who owes me": one line per friend with an outstanding balance (name — no date — "owes you <amount>" or "you owe <amount>"), inside the untrusted-data envelope, then a "-- N settled up" note; "-- none" when nothing is owed either way.

name: sw_list_friends
